dataset: DANDI:000011, Li et al. 2016 ALM electrophysiology + optogenetic perturbation
scope: All public behavior+ecephys+ogen NWB sessions in DANDI:000011 satisfying the locked eligibility criteria. Publication-level qualitative effects are known, but no session- or mouse-level perturbation-effect statistic from this analysis was inspected before this lock.

session_eligibility.recording: electrode location contains ALM and at least 10 units with quality == good
session_eligibility.control_trials: at least 10 no-early-lick, hit, no-photostim trials for each left/right instruction with a valid go cue
session_eligibility.perturbation_trials: at least 10 non-early-lick left/right instruction trials whose same-session laser epoch overlaps the locked late-delay window [go-0.6 s, go-0.1 s] by at least 0.25 s
session_eligibility.site_alignment: photostimulation site must match the recorded ALM hemisphere when hemisphere can be determined from metadata

observational_predictor.name: late-delay local choice discriminability
observational_predictor.trial_filter: no early lick, outcome == hit, instruction left/right, no photostimulation
observational_predictor.session_metric: mean per-unit metric across good ALM units

causal_outcome.name: matched late-delay photoinhibition behavioral impairment
causal_outcome.definition: For each instruction separately, control hit rate minus matched photostimulation hit rate among no-early-lick performing trials; session outcome is the equal-weighted mean of available left/right instruction impairments.
causal_outcome.direction: larger positive values mean greater behavioral impairment

primary_hypothesis: Mice with stronger control-trial late-delay local ALM choice discriminability will show larger matched late-delay ALM photoinhibition impairment.
primary_test: one-sided random permutation test of positive association, 500000 permutations, seed 20261012
success_criterion: rho > 0, one-sided permutation P < 0.05, and leave-one-mouse-out linear-prediction R2 > 0
secondary_outputs: 95% mouse bootstrap interval for Spearman rho
session-level descriptive Spearman correlation (not inferential because sessions repeat mice)
association adjusted descriptively for median laser power if power is recoverable
no_tuning_rule: After the first perturbation-effect computation, no changes to predictor window, unit threshold, trial filters, overlap threshold, aggregation, hypothesis direction, or primary endpoint may be promoted to the locked primary analysis. Any subsequent analyses are post-reveal sensitivity analyses.
schema_only_prelock_inspection: Before freezing, only NWB structure and stimulation-design metadata were inspected; the workflow did not compute control-vs-photostim behavioral effect sizes.
